6 Feature Map
In AUTOSAR variant handling, variation points are controlled by system constants.
Each variation point contains a boolean expression1 which determines whether this
variation point is “on” or “off”. The AUTOSAR formula language allows references to
SwSystemconsts as operands (see [TPS_GST_00001]). This is the same type of
expressions that are used to model restrictions for FMFeatures, except that those
are based on references to other FMFeatures in place of references to SwSystem-
consts.
So, in order to associate features with variation points, we need a data structure that
assigns values to SwSystemconsts based on which features are selected. This is
implemented by the class FMFeatureMap.
